images.prompt: A multi-line graph comparing the shapes of the Normal distribution and several Student's t-distributions with different degrees of freedom (e.g., df=1, df=5, df=30). The x-axis is labeled "Value" and the y-axis is labeled "Probability Density". The Normal distribution is shown as a solid line, and the t-distributions are shown as dashed lines, illustrating how t-distributions have fatter tails than the Normal distribution, especially with lower degrees of freedom, and converge to the Normal as df increases.
